name: Sword World 2.0 Ike! Ken no Sekai de Boukensha
original_name: ソード・ワールド2.0 行け！剣の世界で冒険者
source:
Game provides Sword World 2.0 tabletop experience in the form of a game scenario.
In episode 1 "Requiem for Battle" main character is unable to buy a map of an unexplored dungeon, so he goes to an already explored by veteran adventurer dungeon in hope to find leftover or concealed treasure.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作以游戏剧本的形式，提供《Sword World 2.0》的桌上角色扮演体验。
第一话“战斗安魂曲”中，主人公买不起未经探索的地下城地图，于是前往一座资深冒险者已经探索过的地下城，希望在那里找到遗留或隐藏的宝藏。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
